name: The Sand Sea
description: A vast, shifting plain of fine pale sand that no one crosses on foot, and that the royal skimmer crosses like water.

drift_a.name: The Open Drift
drift_a.description: The skimmer rides a long swell of pale sand under a white sky. Ashmere's boathouse is a smear to the south; a great round shadow in the sand lies to the north.

drift_b.name: The Wind-Scoured Drift
drift_b.description: The sand here has been combed into long, parallel ridges by a wind that never stops. The skimmer runs along them, singing. The Glass Dunes lie low to the west.

basin_rim.name: The Rim of the Basin
basin_rim.description: The sand slopes down into a vast round basin, a spiral of loose, sliding grains forty fathoms across, drawing everything toward a dark mouth at its heart. The skimmer rides the rim, and does not stop. A path of packed stone winds down into the funnel.
